paths.title: Where things are
paths.description: Where the app found Content Manager and Assetto Corsa. Correct anything it got wrong.
paths.clearHint: Forget the folder you picked and detect it again

content.title: Installed content
content.description: Folder names are IDs, so mods count exactly like official content.
content.blocked: Locate the Assetto Corsa install before scanning content.
content.hidden: Not in our catalogue: {{cars}} and {{tracks}}. Those are anonymous mods, so the car and track libraries leave them out until you add them yourself.

browse.locateFirst: Locate Assetto Corsa before browsing installed content.

settings.title: Settings
settings.weatherHint: Which mod renders the weather. This is a property of your install rather than of a race, so it is chosen once here.
settings.weatherPlanWarning: A session whose weather changes needs the planner app running. Note that it saves the last plan it ran over its own, so a plan you had loaded there will be replaced.
settings.allowedWeatherHint: Which weather championships may generate and the race screen offers. Anything left out is swapped for the nearest weather that is allowed, so a wet round stays wet.
settings.driverHint: Fills in a new career, and is who you race as in quick races. A career has a driver of its own, set in its own settings.
settings.driverNameHint: Leave this empty to race under whatever name Assetto Corsa picks.
settings.drivingAidsHint: The aids you drive with in quick races, and in every career that does not set its own.
settings.contentManagerHint: Flags Content Manager reads when it starts. They live in its own Arguments.txt, so anything you put there by hand stays where it is.
settings.contentManagerRestart: Content Manager reads these the next time it starts.
settings.contentManagerMissing: Content Manager has no Arguments.txt yet. Turning any of these on creates it.
settings.calendarHint: Every championship races on a day of the week of its own: the top tier on Sunday, the next on Saturday, and the rest on a weekday.
settings.sameDayEvents: Race two events on one day
settings.sameDayEventsHint: Off, two of your events on the same day clash and racing one gives the other up. On, you can race both.
settings.opponentsHint: How strong and how aggressive the AI are - your difficulty in quick races, and in every career that does not set its own. Every championship states its field as a step up or down from it.
settings.opponentsOffsets: A championship, a class and a round may each move these, and so may you, for a season or a round of your career on its own page. Every driver sits a little either side of their class for the season. A change reaches the next session launched, an event part-way through included, and each session records the strength it ran at.
settings.appearanceHint: How the app looks and reads.

historic.label: Historic events
historic.hint: Single events from racing's past, drawn at random each year from the events switched on and put on weekdays. You're invited to every one; decline any you don't want.
historic.nextSeason: Takes effect from next season - this season's historic events stay as they were drawn.
historic.weekly: Advancing stops at each one. You're invited to every historic event, so weekly means the clock stops every week unless you decline.
historic.pool: Choose which events can be drawn

scope.label: Whose settings
scope.appNote: Every career, championship and quick race

settings.careerDriverHint: This career's own. Your default driver, in the app's settings, stays as it is.
settings.careerOpponentsHint: Every championship's offsets sit over these. The steps you take per season and per round stay on their own pages.
settings.careerAidsHint: The aids this career's sessions launch with.

follow.followingHint: Switch on to set this career apart.
follow.ownHint: Switch off to follow App settings again.

settings.savesHint: What a career keeps of itself along the way, besides the saves you make.

autosaves.label: Autosaves to keep
autosaves.hint: One is taken after every session and as each season begins, and the oldest goes.

settings.championshipDriverHint: This championship's own. Your default driver, in the app's settings, stays as it is.
settings.championshipAidsHint: The aids this championship's sessions launch with.

followChampionship.followingHint: Switch on to set this championship apart.

currency.title: Currency
currency.label: Show money in
currency.hint: Display only: {{amount}} is the same amount whichever you pick, and nothing is converted.
currency.appHint: Dollars, euros or pounds - what every career shows unless it sets its own.
currency.careerHint: Dollars, euros or pounds - what this career's money is shown in.

settings.progressionHint: How fast this career earns and how fast it climbs - two speeds, set apart.
settings.prizeSpeedHint: Scales every prize from the next one on; what is already paid stays. Entry fees stay what each championship says. Each change is a line in Finances.
settings.ratingSpeedHint: Scales every change of rating, up and down alike - a faster career, not an easier one. Each change is a line in the rating log.

carClasses.subtitle: A spec is a grid of cars that can race each other, and a class is the family it belongs to. The app ships its own; add classes and specs of yours beside them. Open a spec to see its cars and put any installed car in it.
carClasses.deleteClassBody: The class is removed with every spec in it, and every car in those specs is taken off them. A championship still racing in one of them stops the delete.
carClasses.deleteSpecBody: The spec is removed and every car in it is taken off it. A championship still racing in it stops the delete.
carClasses.copyHint: The copy is yours to change. Every spec comes along with the same cars in it, named after the new class.
carClasses.moveSpecHint: Its cars go with it. A car already racing in a spec of the class it moves to stops the move.
carClasses.sheetHint: The name and the cars are saved together.
carClasses.nameLocked: A spec the app ships keeps its name, since its championships refer to it. Its cars are still yours to change.
carClasses.noCarsHint: Add the cars that race on this grid. A car holds one spec per class, so one already in this class moves here.

yourContent.subtitle: Mods our catalogue does not know. Switch one on to put it in the car and track libraries, the race screen's pickers and the championship editor.

setup.title: Welcome to Assetto Corsa Career
setup.pathsBlocked: Locate all three folders to continue.
setup.anonymous: {{cars}} and {{tracks}} are mods our catalogue does not know. You can add them to your library later, from Settings.
setup.strengthHint: How fast the AI are. Every championship sets its field a step up or down from this.

steps.pathsHint: Where Content Manager, Assetto Corsa and its Documents folder are. Correct anything the app got wrong.
steps.scanHint: Reads every car, track and weather you have installed, mods included. Folder names are IDs, so mods count exactly like official content.
steps.yoursHint: Everything here can be changed later in Settings.
steps.sourcesHint: Switch on the DLC and mods you have.
steps.tracksHint: Choose a track for each layout the app did not find.

race.title: Races
race.subtitle: Race events of your own, outside any championship.

car.label: Your car
car.anyCar: Any installed car. With no classes yet, it becomes the field: a race of that car alone.
car.replacesClass: Any installed car. It takes the place of {{class}}'s car, keeping its size and drivers.
car.classFirst: Pick what {{class}} races first. Your car comes from its cars.

conditions.slotHint: The weather moves through these in order. The last one holds until the session ends, however long it turns out to be.

launch.waiting: Waiting for the session to finish. This window steps aside and comes back when the result lands.

pick.carHint: Search and filter exactly as the car browser does; if the car has more than one livery you choose that next.
pick.skinHint: A livery is what the car wears on track, and on a mod car it often carries a real number, team and driver with it.
pick.trackHint: Pick the circuit; if it has more than one layout you choose that next.
pick.carsHint: Switch on every car that belongs. Search and filter exactly as the car browser does.
pick.layoutHint_one: {{circuit}} has {{count}} layout. Each races as its own circuit.
pick.layoutHint_other: {{circuit}} has {{count}} layouts. Each races as its own circuit.
pick.fitsAll: Every layout has room for them
pick.tooFewHint: Assetto Corsa drops the cars that do not fit

race.newHint: Pick a track and a car, then the sessions
race.deleteHint: The event and its setup go. Its results stay on the Results page.

classes.title: Classes
classes.hint: What races, and how many of each
classes.noneHint: Pick your car and it becomes the first class, a field of that car alone. Or add a class and pick your car from it.
classes.misfit: Your car is not in this class
classes.name: Name

event.title: Event
event.hint: Each session is a launch of its own
event.wholeHint: What every session runs in unless it says otherwise

calendar.advanceHint: The clock stops at the first event you have entered rather than going past it.
calendar.nothingHint: No championship is switched on, or none of them has a round this season.
calendar.clashHint: Another event you have entered falls on the same day. You can only drive one of them.
calendar.withdrawBody: Every round you have not yet raced becomes a non-start. Points you have already scored stay.

event.noSessions: This round has no sessions that can be run with what is installed.

entry.title: Your entry
entry.season: Car and livery are set for the season

enter.title: Enter {{series}}
enter.body: Entering puts you in a team of the class for the whole season, beside its other driver, and every round goes onto your calendar.
enter.noCars: No installed car can race this class.
enter.unraceable: This round cannot be raced with what is installed.
enter.rentHint: Paid with the entry fee as each round launches.
enter.historicBody: Entering puts you in the last seat of its class, and the event goes onto your calendar.
enter.historicRentHint: Paid with the entry fee as the event launches.
enter.own: Every prize is yours, and a round you skip costs nothing.

seats.hint: Buy a privateer's seat for the season: its car in its colours, every entry fee covered, every prize yours, and no fine for a round you miss. Works teams and independents don't sell theirs.
seats.none: No privateer in this class fields a second car to sell.
seats.title: Buy a seat with {{team}}?
seats.body_one: {{series}}, the {{count}} round still to race, in their {{car}}.
seats.body_other: {{series}}, all {{count}} rounds still to race, in their {{car}}.
seats.price: The seat, paid as you sign
seats.behind: The team's own driver races them in the car.
seats.note: Buying turns down any team's offer for it still waiting. Terminating later gives back half of what the rounds left were worth.
seats.backingHint: Half of this seat, {{amount}}. One backed seat at a time.

brief.authoredDry: As the event sets it, without rain
brief.driedTip: Rain is not allowed, so this runs {{actual}} rather than {{intended}}
brief.pending: Forecast a week before the event

length.title: Race length
length.hint: Picked for this launch alone - the next race starts at full length again
length.floor: Nothing shorter than {{share}}: it would go under {{laps}}.
length.clock: The clock runs ×{{clock}}, so day turns to night as it would over the full race.
length.wear: Fuel use and tyre wear stay the championship's.
length.skip: The race runs shortened to {{share}}, at {{laps}}.

source.from: The grid is the order {{from}} finished in.
source.reversed: The grid is the order {{from}} finished in, with the top {{count}} turned round.
source.previous: The grid is the order the session before finished in.
source.previousReversed: The grid is the order the session before finished in, with the top {{count}} turned round.
source.skill: No qualifying sets this grid: the field lines up on skill.
source.pitLane: Everyone starts from the pit lane.
source.reversedEach: The grid is the order {{from}} finished in, with the top {{count}} of each class turned round.
source.previousReversedEach: The grid is the order the session before finished in, with the top {{count}} of each class turned round.

result.simulated: You were knocked out before this segment, so it was simulated from the one before rather than driven.
result.simulatedRound: You were not there, so the field raced this without you: only the order is known.
result.apartSimulated_one: {{classes}} qualified apart, so its session was simulated: only the order is known.
result.apartSimulated_other: {{classes}} qualified apart, so their sessions were simulated: only the order is known.

skip.title: This round can't be raced as things stand.
skip.titleEvent: This event can't be raced as things stand.
skip.hint: What it needs is not installed. Install it and come back, or skip it: a reserve driver races it in your seat, as for any round you miss.

money.feeNote: The entry fee of {{fee}} is paid as {{session}} launches. A round you skip or miss costs nothing.
money.short: You can't pay for this round
money.shortHint: It costs {{fee}} and you have {{money}}, {{missing}} short. Earn the rest first - a historic event or another championship pays - or skip the round, which costs nothing.
money.rentNote: The rental of {{rent}} is paid as {{session}} launches. A round you skip or miss costs nothing.
money.bothNote: The entry fee of {{fee}} and the rental of {{rent}} are paid as {{session}} launches. A round you skip or miss costs nothing.
money.contractFee: Your half of the entry fee, {{fee}}, is paid as {{session}} launches.
money.salary: Your salary for the round, {{salary}}, is paid once its last race finishes.
money.fine: Missing the round costs {{fine}}, and pays no salary.

ladder.you: You are Tier {{open}} in {{discipline}}. Either opens it:
ladder.youThrough: You are Tier {{open}} in {{discipline}}, through your {{through}} Tier {{best}}. Either opens it:
ladder.throughDetail: {{discipline}} is Tier {{own}} on its own rating. Your {{through}} Tier {{best}} opens it one rung below.
ladder.lift: Entering lifts your {{discipline}} rating from {{from}} to {{to}}, {{metal}}'s floor.

rating.title: Rating
rating.rung: {{metal}}'s field is {{field}} at your own Opponents setting; each point of strength a driver races over it adds 75.
rating.rungHistoric: A historic event is rated on your own rung: {{metal}}'s field is {{field}} at your own Opponents setting, and each point over it adds 75.
rating.held: Held from {{from}}: no race takes more than a third of what it could give.
rating.global: Global moves on the same field, off its own {{from}}: {{change}}.

championships.title: Championships
championships.subtitle: The championships you can race today.

problems.hint: These are files in your own championships folder. The rest of the library is unaffected.
problems.seriesHint: This file does not describe a championship that can be raced. Installing content will not help.

entries.notEnough: Not enough installed to race this class.

calendar.tooFewPitboxes: Only {{available}} pit boxes for a {{needed}}-car field

actions.editLocked: An event of this championship is part-way through

duplicate.title: Duplicate {{name}}
duplicate.hint: The copy is yours to change, and it goes its own way from here: a later update to the original never reaches it.
duplicate.name: Name

edit.title: Edit {{name}}?
edit.body: This is a championship the app ships, so editing it takes your own copy first. The app’s own version is replaced until you revert it.

revert.title: Revert to the app's own championship?
revert.body: Your version of {{name}} is deleted and the app's own comes back. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete this championship?
delete.body: {{name}} is deleted from your library. This cannot be undone.

import.failed_one: {{count}} problem with the file you picked
import.failed_other: {{count}} problems with the file you picked
import.failedHint: Nothing was added to your library.

ladder.alsoOnGrid: Also on the grid, at tier {{tier}}

championships.roundMissing: Round {{number}}: needs content that is not installed

detail.pastSeason: {{edition}}, looked back on: nothing in it can be raced or entered any more.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: What the championship allows and how it is policed. Your own aids are in Settings and are not shown here.

contract.title: Your contract
contract.note: Every round is yours to race - a contract covers the whole season. A round not raced pays no salary and costs its entry fee as a fine, and the team's reserve driver races it. A round that cannot be raced with what is installed is never fined.
contract.noteFree: Every round is yours to race - a contract covers the whole season. A round not raced costs its entry fee as a fine, and the team's reserve driver races it. A round that cannot be raced with what is installed is never fined.
contract.notePaid: Every round is yours to race - a contract covers the whole season. A round not raced costs nothing more, the seat being paid for, and the team's reserve driver races it.
contract.terminateBody: With {{count}} of {{rounds}} rounds still to race.
contract.release: Release fee - a quarter of each round's fine still to race, never less than one fine
contract.noReleaseValue: None - a paid seat is never fined
contract.refund: Seat refund - half of what the rounds left were worth
contract.after: The team puts another driver in the car for the rest of the season. Your points so far stay on the table.
contract.keepPlace: Top {{place}}, or ahead of your teammate
contract.keepAlways: Always - a paid seat renews if you will pay again
contract.judged: Judged as next season's offers go out
contract.releasedHint: The team let you go as next season's offers went out

keptHint.offered: Its offer is in next season's mail
keptHint.renewed: You signed on again for next season

contract.renewed: Renewed after your P{{place}} - it was {{amount}}

offers.title: Seats on offer
offers.beforeHint: Eight weeks before the opening round. Entering now means racing on your own - no team will offer you a seat in it after.
offers.declines_one: Entering on your own declines the seat offer for it.
offers.declines_other: Entering on your own declines the {{count}} seat offers for it.

championshipLibrary.fillerHint: Where the app's own championships leave a rung of a ladder empty, the rung below is repeated there with longer races, marked + and ++. They keep a career climbing without a gap; switch them off if you would rather step straight up.
championshipLibrary.sourcesHint: Which championships are offered, by the content they need. This hides championships and nothing else: your cars and tracks stay in the library either way.
championshipLibrary.unavailable: Not on the Championships page: content it needs is not installed.
championshipLibrary.kunosHint: The base game and its DLC packs.
championshipLibrary.modsHint: Third-party cars and tracks the catalogue recognises.
championshipLibrary.modsFooter: A source switched off hides the championships whose cars need it.
championshipLibrary.specHint: A championship that only races a spec stays offered while any car of its grid is left.

editor.notFound: That championship is no longer in the library.
editor.shipped: This is a championship the app ships, so there is no file of yours to edit. Take a copy of it first.

problems.hint: These are checked as you type and nothing is written until you save. A championship that does not validate can still be saved, but it cannot be raced.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: The changes you have made to {{name}} have not been written yet.

locked.title: This championship cannot be edited yet
locked.body: An event of it is part-way through. Everything below decides what the next session's grid holds, so the document is locked until that event is finished or reset.

details.name: Name
details.entryFeeShort: Per round, unless a round says otherwise. Zero is free to enter.
details.seasonLengthShort: How much of a career's year it fills
details.raceWeekdayShort: By tier, the top tier races on Sunday, the next on Saturday and the rest on a weekday of their own
details.generatedWeatherShort: Drawn from a climate; a round or a session may still set its own
details.rainShort: Turn off if a car you race here cannot handle a wet track
details.rainOffShort: Every session runs dry, whatever the weather would have been

regulations.title: Regulations
regulations.hint: What the series allows, and what it does when the rules are broken. These are the rules rather than what you drive with - your own aids are in Settings - and an empty field is whatever Assetto Corsa ships.
regulations.jumpStartPenaltyHint: A drive-through of this length for leaving early.
regulations.allowedTyresOutHint: How many wheels may leave the track before a cut counts.

teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Name
teams.formHint: A team is described once and every seat it runs points at it.

budgetHint.works: Factory backed: the fastest cars and drivers
budgetHint.independent: A customer team with a serious budget

teams.hintShort: Described once, pointed at by every seat it runs.

budgetTip.works: The car maker's own team, or one it backs. The best funded on the grid - it pays its drivers a salary, and wants proven ones.
budgetTip.independent: A professional team with no maker behind it, racing cars it bought on its own money and sponsors. It can cover a driver's costs, but rarely pays a salary.
budgetTip.privateer: A small team on a tight budget, often a family's or a driver's own. Its drivers usually pay for their seats.

entries.title: Classes
entries.hint: One way into the championship per class it runs, each with its own rung of the ladder, its own cars and its own standings. Most championships run a single class.
entries.name: Name
entries.tierHint: 1 is the top of a discipline. A driver may enter any series at or below their level in it.
entries.prizesHint: What this class pays, in place of the championship’s own prize money. A multi-class grid pays its classes differently; classes sharing a purse leave both tables empty.
entries.formHint: What the class is called and where on the ladder it sits. Its cars, its seats, its AI field and its prize money are on its own tabs.
entries.needsCar: Pick a car to start the class with.
entries.teamsFromHint: Another class's teams, seat by seat
entries.fastestFirstTip: On a grid with faster classes first, every car of a class starts ahead of the classes below it.

eligibility.noCars: No cars named yet. A class that names none cannot be raced.

bop.hint: A balanced car is outlined. Zero runs the car as it is.
bop.noCars: None of the class's cars is installed, so there is nothing to balance.

seats.unpin: Take the pinned car off this seat
seats.unnamed: Empty - races as an AI driver
seats.hint: The player takes the last seat of the class they enter.

roundEligibility.hint: Which cars each class runs here instead of its usual ones. Only the car varies - the entry list, the calendar and the standings stay at championship level.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.empty: No rounds yet. A championship needs at least one.
calendar.name: Name
calendar.entryFeeHint: Overrides the championship's, for this round alone.
calendar.conditionsHint: What this round runs in, unless one of its sessions says otherwise.
calendar.tooFewPitboxes: Only {{available}} pit boxes for a {{needed}}-car field
calendar.raceLengthHint: Empty runs what the event format says.
calendar.caption: Round {{number}} of {{count}}
calendar.dialogNote: Nothing is written until the championship is saved
calendar.formatHint: The default unless a round runs a different format.
calendar.hintShort: Click a round to edit it. Drag to reorder.

formats.title: Event formats
formats.name: Name
formats.hintShort: Every way this championship runs an event. A round names one when it differs from the default.

sessions.name: Name
sessions.conditionsWin: A group set here wins over the round's, wherever this format is raced.
sessions.pointsHint: A race paying a table of its own is what makes a sprint a sprint.
sessions.raceLengthHint: A race runs laps or a distance - Assetto Corsa times a race on a server alone.
sessions.youStartHint: Nothing before this race sets its grid, so the field lines up on pace, class by class. A random slot is drawn once and stays put.
sessions.conditionsWinEvent: A group set here wins over the event's own.
sessions.onGridTip: A faster class is one listed higher among the classes.
sessions.apartBehind: {{name}} runs each class apart, so the classes line up apart too.

points.title: Points systems
points.name: Name
points.empty: Nothing scores. Every position pays zero.
points.startFromHint: Clicking one replaces the tables below with it, after asking. Everything stays editable afterwards.
points.finishingSummary_one: Place 1 scores. The + after the last place adds one.
points.finishingSummary_other: Places 1 - {{count}} score. The + after the last place adds one.
points.qualifyingSummary_one: Pole scores. Drop it to pay nothing for qualifying.
points.qualifyingSummary_other: The top {{count}} in qualifying score. Drop them all to pay nothing for qualifying.
points.fastestLapSwitch: Pay for the fastest lap of the race
points.paidByHint: The same choice each race's own Pays field makes on the Formats tab, gathered here.
points.replaceBody: The finishing places, the qualifying places and the fastest lap are all replaced.
points.pick: Pick a system to edit it
points.hintShort: Every way this championship scores a race.

purse.replaces: Changing the pot, the places or the shape generates the table again and replaces the places you adjusted.
purse.nothing: Pays nothing. Enter what it pays in all to generate the places.
purse.raceHint: Paid for a finishing place at every round
purse.seasonHint: Paid once, for the final standings

classPrizes.compare: The championship pays {{championship}} a race - {{name}} pays {{own}}
classPrizes.start: Give {{name}} its own purse, starting from the championship's
classPrizes.dropBody: The prize money {{name}} pays of its own is dropped.
classPrizes.feeHint: What entering {{name}} costs a round, in place of the championship's fee. Leave it empty to charge that.

prizeMoney.hint: What the championship pays. A class may pay its own instead, on its own tab.

hints.weather: Holds for the whole session, or changes as it runs
hints.time: The whole day, midnight to midnight
hints.temperature: The air, and the road it warms
hints.track: How much rubber is down at the start

days.empty: Nothing runs on this day yet. Drag a session here or click to add one.
days.remove: Remove the day, moving its sessions onto the day before
days.removeFirst: Remove the day, moving its sessions onto the day after

temperature.followsHint: Warms and cools with the air and the time of day.

weather.changesHint: A sequence of weathers, each for a while
weather.chequered: Chequered flag - however long the race runs
weather.dropBody_one: Keep only the first slot's weather and drop the other one?
weather.dropBody_other: Keep only the first slot's weather and drop the other {{count}}?
weather.needsPlanner: Needs PURE or Sol - not what settings says you race with
weather.planKept: Settings races with a weather system that cannot change the weather, so a plan written elsewhere is kept but only its first weather runs here.

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Every event you have driven, newest first.
results.notFound: That result is no longer there.

order.raceResultHint: Classified by Assetto Corsa itself, which is why it cannot inherit a sorting bug of ours.
order.inferredHint: Practice and qualifying carry no classification of their own, so this order is sorted from the lap data.

results.search: Search a championship, round or track

cars.title: Cars
cars.searchPlaceholder: Search cars by name, brand, folder or tag

detail.searchPlaceholder: Search liveries by name, driver, team or number
detail.unclassified: It races on no grid yet.

cars.subtitle: Every car in your library, and which championships race it.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.searchPlaceholder: Search tracks by name, folder or country
tracks.subtitle: Every circuit in your library, and which championships race there.
tracks.locatedHint: Located - the sun and the weather follow its real position

detail.layoutsHint: Pick one to see it alone
detail.unlocatedHint: The track gives none, so Custom Shaders Patch can only guess where the sun stands.
detail.locatedHint: Custom Shaders Patch sets the sun for the real place and its time zone.
detail.author: Author

forecast.title: Event forecast
forecast.hint: Generated from the round's climate. The race runs in exactly this weather.
forecast.substituted: {{intended}} is switched off or not installed, so this runs {{actual}} instead
forecast.authored: Set by the championship rather than generated
forecast.unavailable: No allowed weather is installed, so none is set

cmFlagHint.--skip-all-results: Content Manager shows its own results screen after every session. Without it you come back here sooner.
cmFlagHint.--hide-race-cancel-button: Puts a cancelled race more than one misclick away. Quitting does not abort a race either way - Assetto Corsa finishes it without you.

diagnostics.readyDetail: Content Manager, Assetto Corsa and your Documents folder are all found, and your content is scanned.
diagnostics.notFound: Locate all three folders below before anything can launch.
diagnostics.notScanned: Everything is found - scan your content below to fill the library.

home.clashWith: {{names}} is on the same day. You can only drive one of them.
home.noneEntered: You have not entered a championship this season.
home.noEventHint: Enter a championship and its next round shows up here.

finished.title: {{series}} is over - you finished P{{position}}
finished.titleChampion: {{series}} is over - you are the champion

yearDone.title: Your {{year}} is done
yearDone.hint: Everything you entered this year has been raced. Look back over the year, then move on to {{next}} - or enter something that still runs before 31 December.
yearDone.note: Finishing moves the clock to {{day}}. Nothing carries over - you enter {{next}}'s championships afresh.

newSeason.title: {{year}} is open
newSeason.hint: Nothing is entered yet. Here is what you raced last year - each opens its championship with your class and car already picked.

results.title: Results
results.none: Nothing driven yet - every session you run lands here.

history.title: History
history.hint: Every season of your career, and each championship's review

finances.title: Finances
finances.hint: Your money, and every change of it

rating.title: Rating
rating.hint: Where you stand on the ladder

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.none: Racing on your own this season

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.hint: Who backs you, and what they want

historic.heading: Historic events
